install.headline: Put the game on your home screen and it works without the internet.
install.body: The browser adds the icon itself. No app store, nothing to download.
install.installed: The game is already on your home screen. You can open it offline.
install.buttonHint: Add it from the game itself, not from this page.

ios.title: iPhone, Safari
steps: Open the game in Safari - Chrome and Firefox on iPhone cannot do this.
Tap Share - the button at the bottom of the screen.
Open it from the home screen once while online - after that it works with no network.

android.title: Android, Chrome
steps: In the browser menu (three dots) choose Install app.
Open it from the home screen once while online - after that it works with no network.

desktop.title: Desktop, Chrome or Edge
steps: Open the game in Chrome or Edge.
On the game page an install icon appears at the right of the address bar. Click it.
Open it once while online - after that it works with no network.

install.fallback: On iPhone only Safari can add the icon. Open the game there.
